content:
Friday night football in Week 10 brought wins for United, LBJ and Martin, and losses for Alexander, Nixon, Cigarroa and Bruni, according to the Sports Illustrated High School On SI Laredo scoreboard for October 30, 2026.

United beat Del Rio 38-6, LBJ beat Alexander 17-3, and Martin beat South San Antonio 28-14, the scoreboard shows. Eagle Pass Winn beat Nixon 30-6, Sharyland beat Cigarroa 31-12, and Knippa beat Bruni 46-0.

Two other finals on the Laredo scoreboard: Edcouch-Elsa beat Zapata 46-12, and Hebbronville beat Falfurrias 81-0.

The Nixon loss came on Winn's homecoming night in Eagle Pass, where Winn crowned its homecoming court at halftime in the 30-6 win, according to the Eagle Pass Business Journal.

Sources:

  • Sports Illustrated High School On SI, Laredo Football Scores, October 30, 2026
  • Eagle Pass Business Journal, "Eagle Pass C. C. Winn High School Crowns 2026 Homecoming Royalty Amid Mavericks Victory Over Laredo Nixon Mustangs 30-6," October 31, 2026
